name: sha256chain_bulk
description: Bulk hashing of a 64 KiB buffer (#10): SHA-256 plain C, Zknh, RVV multi-buffer x16 (16 segments), accelerator SHA-512 and SHA3-256 (streaming engine)
expect: KAT FIPS 180-4 SHA-256 OK: C, Zknh, RVV x16
KAT FIPS 180-4 SHA-512 / FIPS 202 SHA3-256 OK: accelerator
units: KiB of message per region (the buffer is iterations KiB)

sdk.description: SDK default -march (rv64gcv + B, Zbc, Zcb, Zicond, Zbk*, Zkn*): every implementation is in the one image
